lines.zh: 我沿着河岸慢吞吞地挪
lines.en: I plod along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 四条短腿走得很有节奏
lines.en: My four short legs keep a rhythm.

lines.zh: 我踩着泥，留下宽宽的印
lines.en: My feet leave wide prints in the mud.
Water plants tear at my muzzle.
I walk at the back of the line.
A companion walks ahead; I am in no hurry.
Ducks in the river trail after me.
With this body, I cannot go fast.
I chew while I walk.
It is hot; I keep to the shade.
The bank grass flattens behind me.
I stop to watch the light on the water.
Half-lidded, I bask in the sun.
I sit and do not move.
The water's edge is comfortable.
I chew the grass and swallow slowly.
There are fish in the water beside me.
The sun has warmed my fur.

lines.zh: 我不介意别的动物靠近
lines.en: I do not mind other animals near.
I dip my nose in the water.
My ear flicks at a fly.
I yawn, widely.
I come to this shallow often.
I see the clouds on the water.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，嘴里还有草
lines.en: I look up at you with grass in my mouth.
You stand; I sit.

lines.zh: 你身上有食物的味道吗
lines.en: Do you carry the smell of food?
I just look at you.
You need not crouch.
I shift a little to one side.
You come nearer; I still do not rise.
My nose twitches twice.
You are looking at the bird on my back.
My temper is good. Truly.

lines.zh: 你把影子投在我身上，很凉
lines.en: Your shadow falls cool on me.
I wait for you to say something.
Are you going to touch me?
I turn my head back slowly.
My reflection is in the water.
You go your way; I stay sitting.
Startled, I back away.
That made me cry out.
I cannot run fast, so I hide.
I turn to guard my flank.
A scratch on my hide.
I shrink into the grass.

lines.zh: 水就在旁边，我往那边去
lines.en: The water is near; I head for it.
I pant heavily.
By the river at dusk, I soak still.
I can still walk.
Fruit. I smell it.
I do not snatch; I wait.
One bite. Very sweet.
This beats grass by far.
I sit down to signal I want it.
This tastes a little odd.
I will come back when it is gone.
I can smell the fresh grass from here.
I bump you, like a soft wall.
I step back, very slowly.
You push; I sway.
My body is heavy.
We collide and neither falls.
I am not angry; I just shift over.
Water splashes my belly.
You nearly tripped over me.
That made my legs buckle.
At the waterside this comes naturally.
We soak side by side in the water.
The little ones walk at birth.
My whole family stays in the shallows.
Companions lean against each other.
I do not compete; I simply wait.

lines.zh: 太阳下山的时候最安静
lines.en: It is quietest when the sun sets.
We soak in the water for warmth.
Neither of us fusses. Good.
This bank is enough for us.
I lower my head to bite it.
Not food; I let it go.
This is a little heavy.
I chew once and spit it out.
It fell in the mud; now it is dirty.
I drag it under the tree.
I carry it in my mouth.
Whoever threw it, I will take it.
I look at it and lose interest.
My attention is very short.
I glance, then lower my head again.
I do not fight.
At most I stand up.
I back toward the water.
The water protects me.
My companions are heading that way.
You are disturbing me.
I am only changing spots.
This direction is safer.
The water is close.
I will simply walk away.
Do not chase me.
I am not going over there.
I walk and look back.
You are still following.
Not fast, but I do not stop.
The water is right beside me.

lines.zh: 我在找一块安静的地方
lines.en: I am looking for a quiet spot.
The grass here has all been grazed.
I go around the far side of the tree.
I dislike being surrounded.
My companions are over there.
Your footsteps are very close.
I change direction.
The water is safer.
I settle slowly down into the water.
You can only chase me on the bank.
I lift my head for one look at you.
I am going now.
This will do.
I move along the water.
I butt with my head.
My teeth are not small either.
That was only a bluff.
I bite your hem.
I shove you toward the water.
I rarely do this.
My foot lands on yours.
This was not my intent.
I pull back, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 你要是不追我，我就不动
lines.en: If you stop chasing, I stop.
That was very light.
I push you off a ways.
The water splashes up.
I still want to leave.
Do not come near my companions.
I am soaking in the shallows.
The bank grass is tender.
The sun is rather strong.
First I take a drink.

lines.zh: 这里是傍晚常来的地方
lines.en: This is my usual evening spot.
I clamber slowly onto the mudflat.
Companions graze nearby.
The water is quiet.
There is a bird above me.
I turn my body around.
The mud is warm.
I settle down comfortably.
The air smells of green grass.
I look around; nothing much.
I tuck my four legs under.
Someone is singing far off.
One could stay here a long while.
Fire singes my fur.
I tumble off the bank.
Water reaches my nose.
The blast flings me into the mud.
Something sticks in my back.
Hungry enough to chew bark.
No grass and no water here.
